# P04 development experiment on assessment-plan changes

Question: can the first 56 days of activity identify a change in a course's assessment structure, using a separate publisher table as the reference? Use all consecutive published offerings within each module of OULAD, in chronological order. An edge is positive if the vector of counts of released exams, tutor-marked assignments and computer-marked assignments differs. Dates, weights, content, official curriculum levels and future learner outcomes are outside this definition. Reference labels come solely from assessments.csv; exclude its fields from all scores. This observational proxy tests the benchmark's ability to recognize an actual structural edit. It does not label instructional harm.

Score each offering using learner-week shares of the released VLE activity types. First sum clicks within learner/week/type, normalize each active learner-week to one, then average across learners within each week. Weeks 0 through 7 have equal weight. The candidate averages weekwise Jensen–Shannon distances after mapping quiz and externalquiz to assessment interactions and all other types to other. Controls retain all activity types with or without week alignment, remove week alignment from the candidate, compare raw pooled clicks, compare the inventories of released resource types, or predict any transition between February and October starts. Include a direct mean absolute weekly difference of assessment-interaction shares to isolate the distance function. Use the same set of transitions for all scores.

Report average precision and recall at a false-discovery proportion of at most .10. Select each detector's operating threshold from the other modules only, maximizing calibration recall subject to that constraint with higher threshold resolving ties. Include the empty selection. Recompute rankings from two disjoint student hash halves to describe stability. A development advance requires at least .05 AP improvement over every comparator plus strictly higher cross-validated recall at the specified discovery limit. Count independent modules and positive edges. Restrict any claim to this release. Do not treat correlated transitions as independent replications.
